statement: US Central Command announces at least one new strike on Iranian forces, vessels, or territory occurring between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A CENTCOM release or two of Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera report a US strike on Iranian forces or territory dated between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No US strike on Iranian forces, vessels, or territory occurs inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
